content:
hana: Quick sync / MidnightBridge wants a 48h technical POC to validate migration from their current LLM vendor. Top requirements: identical HTTP surface, preserved webhook callback shape, and clear token accounting. Theyre worried about billing deltas.

pete: Their current API returns a final POST to their callback with fields: request_id, result.text, and meta.tokens_used. We need to mirror that exactly (including meta.tokens_used as an int). I can add a response shim.

olga: Note on streaming: they don't support chunked streaming; they always wait for the final JSON. We'll buffer at the proxy and POST the single final payload to their callback URL.

samir: Parity plan: run a paired set of 2k prompts, compute token counts under both tokenizers, produce a diff table and a semantic similarity score (embedding cosine + ROUGE). I'll flag >15% variance. Need a small Dedicated slot for deterministic runs. Prep ETA 22h.

frank: Security wants: completed questionnaire, SOC2 subreport excerpt, IP allowlist, and HMAC-signed callbacks (X-MB-Sig). Also they asked about KMS wrapping for persisted logs. I already sent them the questionnaire link.

hana: Legal asked for a POC addendum: 30-day retention, no secondary use, and POC liability limited. We can do that; who owns purge?

olga: I will add a POC tag and a scheduled purge job that deletes all POC artifacts after 30 days. Will write the runbook and link it here.

samir: Smoke curl for their inbound webhook producer (replace KEY):

```
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.dev/midnightbridge/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize customer billing ledger","callback_url":"https://hooks.midnightbridge.com/callback"}'
```

Proxy will run model, buffer, then POST final payload to their callback with request_id preserved and X-MB-Sig header.

pete: Pricing Q from MidnightBridge: can we bill 1:1 with their old vendor? Short answer: not guaranteed due to tokenizer differences. For the POC we propose a fixed 100k token trial credit and reconcile after we calculate a multiplier from the paired run.

frank: For Hosted vs Dedicated: Dedicated in their VPC -> no external logs and easier to enforce 30-day retention. Hosted -> customer-managed KMS possible; will need their KMS ARN. I sent ops CIDRs to their infra team.

hana: Two current blockers: (1) MidnightBridges security team wants the SOC2 subreport and (2) they need our egress IPs for firewall rules. @frank uploaded SOC2_excerpt_redwood.pdf and posted IPs.

sec-bot: egress CIDRs: 18.200.45.0/24, 52.12.88.0/24. SOC2_excerpt_redwood.pdf uploaded to shared drive.

pete: Demo talking points: (1) show before/after payload preservation, (2) token multiplier visualization, (3) deterministic run (temp=0) for stricter parity cases. Also highlight subtle tokenizer differences on legal identifiers.

olga: Also warn: some JSON consumers compare serialized bytes; we preserve insertion order but canonicalization may be needed before byte-level diffs. Recommend canonicalize-json before asserting equality.

samir: I'll produce the first parity report within 48h after dedicated runs start. If legal or security stalls >24h, escalate to AE.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch=midnightbridge/compat-proxy build=612 ETA=5m :rocket:

hana: Action items: @pete implement response shim + demo proxy; @samir run diff job; @frank send SOC2 + egress CIDRs; @olga add purge job + runbook; @legal draft addendum (cc AE). MidnightBridge contact: integrations@midnightbridge.com.

frank: Sent SOC2 and CIDRs to their security team. Waiting on SAML/SP metadata for SSO ask.

hana: OK. Target: POC live and first parity report within 48h. Keep updates here and ping AE if blockers persist. :thumbsup:
